verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships an official CLI (rdme) explicitly designed for docs-as-code workflows, confirmed to install and run headlessly via npx without a browser or interactive login, which is the standard mechanism for driving ReadMe from CI pipelines (e.g., syncing OpenAPI specs on each build). Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/CD examples (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow YAML) and documentation of non-interactive auth/token flags for automation.
